channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: One of two men caught in avalanche in Utah’s Big Cottonwood Canyon dies
item.description: One of the two backcountry skiers caught in a Feb. 21 avalanche in Big Cottonwood Canyon has died from his injuries, the Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office reports.

item.title: AI poem and committee swapping: How Utah Republicans helped an anti-vote-by-mail bill get traction
item.description: Republican lawmakers manipulated Utah’s legislative process to ensure a bill that would impose new restrictions on mail-in ballots would gain traction in the Legislature.

item.title: Push to repeal Prop 4 meets its goal but is on thin ice as signature removals remain
item.description: The Republican push to repeal Prop 4 and restore the Legislature's power to gerrymander political districts is on thin ice, but signature counting continues.

item.title: Jana Riess: Latter-day Saints are opening up about sex
item.description: LDS therapist Jennifer Finlayson-Fife says Latter-day Saints are becoming more comfortable talking openly and frankly about sex — all to the benefit of their marriages.

item.title: ‘Mormon Land’: Humorist Eli McCann and his husband discuss the laughs and love they find in LDS culture
item.description: Tribune columnist Eli McCann — with husband Skylar Westerdahl — discusses his new book, “We’re Thankful for the Moisture: A Gay Guy’s Guide to Mormon Faith, Family, and Fruit Preservation."

item.title: Bingham girls shut down Lone Peak en route to Class 6A title
item.description: The Miners held the Knights to just 16% shooting.

item.title: State threatens to pull trendy Salt Lake City brunch spot’s liquor license over tax dispute
item.description: Sunday’s Best in Salt Lake City's Post District was able to provide the required information and their liquor license won't be suspended, a DABS spokesperson said.

item.title: 2 alleged gang members face firearm charges after LDS church shooting
item.description: An unsealed indictment charges two alleged Tongan Crip Gang Members, one a convicted felon, with firearm charges following the shooting at a church in Salt Lake City.

item.title: Pleasant Grove caps perfect season with a state championship
item.description: Vikings point guard Janiece Sikander scored 21 points to lead her team in the title game.

item.title: Titan triple: Olympus wins its third straight 5A state basketball title
item.description: The Olympus Titans completed a three-peat, beating Bountiful on Friday night for the school's third straight 5A state basketball title.
